failures.question: 2018 年每个月的订单量相比 2017 年同期增长了多少？

SELECT extract(month from order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS month,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(year from order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017) AS orders_2017,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(year from order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018) AS orders_2018,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(year from order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018)

FROM orders

failures.question: 当前等级与最近一次会员快照等级不一致的会员有多少？按等级组合统计。
failures.generatedSql:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (member_id)
    member_id,
    level_id
  FROM member_snapshot
  ORDER BY member_id, snapshot_date DESC, snapshot_id DESC
)
SELECT
  cur.level_code AS current_level_code,
  cur.level_name AS current_level_name,
  snap.level_code AS snapshot_level_code,
  snap.level_name AS snapshot_level_name,
  COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM members m
JOIN latest_snapshot ls ON ls.member_id = m.member_id
JOIN member_levels cur ON cur.level_id = m.level_id
JOIN member_levels snap ON snap.level_id = ls.level_id
WHERE m.level_id <> ls.level_id
GROUP BY cur.level_code, cur.level_name, snap.level_code, snap.level_name
ORDER BY member_count DESC
LIMIT 100;

failures.question: 按英文类目和退款原因统计退款笔数与退款金额，列出前 20。
failures.generatedSql:
WITH refund_cat AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    ri.refund_id,
    COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category
  FROM refund_items ri
  JOIN order_items oi
    ON ri.order_id = oi.order_id
   AND ri.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  JOIN products p
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  LEFT JOIN product_category_translation t
    ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
)
SELECT
  rc.category,
  r.reason_code,
  COUNT(*) AS refund_count,
  SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount
FROM refunds r
JOIN refund_cat rc
  ON r.refund_id = rc.refund_id
GROUP BY rc.category, r.reason_code
ORDER BY refund_count DESC, refund_amount DESC
LIMIT 20;

failures.question: 运费占 GMV 的比例是多少？按宏观区域拆解。
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT r.macro_region,
       SUM(oi.freight_value) AS freight_total,
       SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv_with_freight,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value) / SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) * 100, 2) AS freight_ratio_pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN regions r ON c.customer_state = r.region_code
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY r.macro_region
ORDER BY freight_ratio_pct DESC
LIMIT 100;
